What the record shows

In October 2026 Schneider Electric agreed to buy the engineering software maker PTC in an all-cash deal at $205 per share 3. "The acquisition of PTC represents an important step forward in our ambition to lead the new era of energy and industrial intelligence," CEO Olivier Blum said 4.

Dated Signals

Oct 5, 2026SiliconANGLE · Silicon Republic

Agrees to acquire PTC

Schneider announced an all-cash deal valuing PTC at $205 per share; SiliconANGLE reports $23.7 billion and Silicon Republic $22.6 billion 3,4. The deal is expected to yield €250 million in annual cost synergies and €800 million in revenue synergies 5.

Oct 10, 2026Data Center Dynamics (sponsored)

Generator-to-chip partnership

Wärtsilä, Schneider Electric and Stanley Consultants launched a coordinated approach integrating onsite generation, electrical infrastructure and engineering for US data centers 6.

Oct 5, 2026DataCenter-Insider

Hybrid air and liquid CDU

Schneider's new coolant distribution unit combines fan-wall air cooling with liquid cooling, at up to 3.5 MW of cooling per unit 7.

Oct 6, 2026DCNN

New head of Secure Power in Europe

Schneider appointed Damien Dhellemmes as Senior Vice President of its Secure Power and Data Center business in Europe 8.

Sep 28, 2026Converge Digest

Software-defined medium voltage

Schneider is extending software-defined architecture into the medium-voltage layer of AI data centers with a standardized switchgear platform 9.

Sep 18, 2026Data Center Dynamics

800 V DC and cooling

Schneider's Mike Donahue discussed 800 V DC and its implications for data center cooling as rack power density rises 10.

Oct 8, 2026Schneider Electric

Cooling design and local approvals

Andrew Whitmore, VP of Sales at Motivair by Schneider Electric, writes that community opposition and local approvals are becoming bigger constraints on capacity development 11.
